description.value: Landmark Cinemas is a major Canadian cinema chain with a Fort St. John location in a commercial area on 93 Avenue. For touring cyclists passing through the Peace River region, it offers a climate-controlled indoor break in a community that sits along the Alaska Highway corridor. It is the only cinema serving this northern BC city.
